chunks: You did not hide your (doings) so that your ears or eyes or persons should not testify against you. In fact you thought that God did not know the things you used to do.
ai.seo_question: Why did disbelievers think God did not know their deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological root of hypocrisy: the delusion that God’s knowledge is limited, leading to a false sense of security in concealment. It underscores the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen), affirming that divine awareness encompasses both the visible and the hidden, rendering bodily testimony merely a manifestation of what was already known. This serves as a practical reminder for believers to maintain constant God-consciousness (Muraqabah) even in private moments.
